title: 天气与出门

words.example: I'll bring a jacket just in case.

sentences.zh: 今天下午看起来要下雨。

sentences.en: I'll bring a jacket just in case.
sentences.zh: 我还是带件外套以防万一。
sentences.speak: I'll bring a jacket just in case.

scenarios.title: 出门前问今天天气
scenarios.setting: 早上要出门，你在门口问同事或室友今天天气怎么样，要不要带外套。

lines.en: Yes. It looks rainy this afternoon.
lines.zh: 看了。今天下午看起来要下雨。
lines.speak: Yes. It looks rainy this afternoon.

lines.en: Thanks. I'll bring a jacket just in case.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我还是带件外套以防万一。
lines.speak: Thanks. I'll bring a jacket just in case.

scenarios.title: 要下雨，临走被提醒带伞
scenarios.setting: 你正要出门，同事看了看天，提醒你下午可能下雨，让你别忘了带伞。

lines.en: Are you leaving now? It looks rainy this afternoon.
lines.zh: 你现在要走吗？今天下午看起来要下雨。
lines.speak: Are you leaving now? It looks rainy this afternoon.

lines.en: Really? I thought it was sunny.
lines.zh: 真的吗？我还以为是晴天。
lines.speak: Really? I thought it was sunny.

lines.en: It is sunny now, but don't forget your umbrella.
lines.zh: 现在是晴天，但别忘了带伞。
lines.speak: It is sunny now, but don't forget your umbrella.

lines.en: Good call. I'll bring a jacket just in case, too.
lines.zh: 说得对。外套我也带上以防万一。
lines.speak: Good call. I'll bring a jacket just in case, too.

lines.en: You might need a jacket. It's cloudy and a bit windy.
lines.zh: 你可能需要外套。现在多云，还有点风。
lines.speak: You might need a jacket. It's cloudy and a bit windy.

task: 把问天气、看预报和临走带伞这几句连着说一遍，录下来自己听
